title: Rings within five places: the eddies and their rates
claim: In the proved class with every knot live and at most five places: Lemma 1, a ring-core start is a ring of L = 5 or L >= 7 knots with hung knots at least three apart and forced open counts except spares (plain core knots 0 or 1, hung knots 0 to 2); Lemma 2, its map is one ring of blocks (L odd) or two (L even); Theorem 3, the per-round count of a piece is [z^(t+1)] of sum_i lambda_(i-1) sum_m prod v_k / (1 - W) + sum over leaves z(1+z)^b, W = z^n (1+z)^A prod (1 + z(1+z)^b); Theorem 4, a bare piece makes n junctions every round, any other grows at the root x > 1 of W(1/x) = 1; Corollary 5, within the cap the in-class eddies are exactly the rings with a hung knot or a spare.
standard_statement: Transfer of a periodic line's connected sets (lattice animals on a decorated line); Pringsheim's theorem for the dominant root.
prior_work: CAP-CHAINS-20261119-001 (the core shapes), DOUBLE-IDENT-20261119-001 and RING-IDENT-20261119-001 (the identification), LOOP-CATALOGUE-20261119-001 (the ring family and interfaces, computed), BREAK-EDDIES-20261119-001.
